title: Red de Naciones (Net Nation Spanish Sister)
style: Cumbia-influenced afro jazz, 96 BPM, female lead vocal warm and spirited, accordion, marimba, congas, walking bass, brass section, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, bilingual Spanish and English, uplifting choir finale, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro - accordion, marimba, congas roll in]
(female warm, spoken Spanish-English)
una nacion en cada cancha.
one nation on every court.
red de naciones, net nation.
toma tu lado.

[Verse 1 - female lead, spirited, brass under]
en cada cancha hay una bandera
en cada cancha hay una manera
de decir buenos dias al companero
de decir gracias al primero
que te ensenó a soltar el bull
that taught you when the kitchen line was full

the net is not a wall, the net is a thread
the net is not a fence, the net is a bed
where two nations sleep and two nations rise
and the held line says vamos with both pairs of eyes

[Pre-Chorus - bilingual, accordion swells]
red de naciones, net nation
en cada cancha, every station
red de naciones, net nation
dos idiomas, una vibration

[Chorus - full duet, brass sings, choir hint]
red de naciones, net nation
two languages, one celebration
red de naciones, net nation
the held line speaks in both directions
red de naciones, net nation
una sola pelota, dos paddles in motion
red de naciones, net nation
the net is the held line of the ocean

[Verse 2 - female, slightly fuller, congas double]
una abuela en Lima jugaba a los setenta
una abuela en Auckland jugaba a los ochenta
se vieron en un torneo en Nicaragua
se rieron, se hablaron, played for cuatro horas straight

porque el pickleball no necesita palabras
pickleball doesn't need a translation
the paddle is the same paddle in any nation
the held line is the held line in any conversation
red de naciones, una vibration

[Pre-Chorus]
red de naciones, net nation
en cada cancha, every station
red de naciones, net nation
dos idiomas, una vibration

[Chorus]
red de naciones, net nation
two languages, one celebration
red de naciones, net nation
the held line speaks in both directions
red de naciones, net nation
una sola pelota, dos paddles in motion
red de naciones, net nation
the net is the held line of the ocean

[Bridge - accordion alone, female spoken bilingual]
the net is not a barrier.
la red no es una barrera.
the net is the conversation.
la red es la conversacion.
two nations on either side, but one game between them.
dos naciones de cada lado, pero un solo juego entre ellos.
that's the whole sport. that's the whole doctrine.
ese es todo el deporte. esa es toda la doctrina.

[Final Chorus - biggest, choir full, brass huge, congas roar]
red de naciones, net nation
two languages, one celebration
red de naciones, net nation
the held line speaks in both directions
red de naciones, net nation
una sola pelota, dos paddles in motion
red de naciones, net nation
the net is the held line of the ocean
red de naciones
net nation

[Outro - accordion fade, congas tail, female whisper bilingual]
toma tu lado, hold your side.
la red sostiene. the net holds.
buenas tardes, kitchen line.
vamos.
